A real, completable platformer — running in your browser

Light the Hollow, one leap at a time.

You are Pip, the last lit firefly of the Dusk Hollow. The great lanterns have gone dark and the grumpy hollow-beetles have moved in. Run, jump and stomp your way across three hand-drawn worlds to relight them — and bring the dawn back.

What's under the hood

A platformer that actually feels good

Lumen Leap is not a slideshow or a video — it is a genuine game engine written from scratch in plain JavaScript. A fixed-timestep loop, a hand-tuned player controller and a tile collision solver give Pip that springy, forgiving, "one more try" feel.

Springy controls

Run acceleration and friction, variable jump height, coyote time and jump buffering — the same "good-feel" tech in your favourite indie platformers.

Hand-built levels

Three tilemaps authored tile-by-tile: gentle Hollow's Edge, the vertical Bramble Climb, and the finale, Lantern's Heart. Every path is verified beatable.

Stomp the beetles

Grumpy hollow-beetles patrol their ledges. Land on one to bounce off it — or take a hit and lose a glimmer. Classic, readable enemy rules.

Moving platforms

Rune-lit platforms drift on sine paths and carry you with them. Time your hops across pits and rise up through the brambles.

Lumens & gems

Collect glowing lumens for points and chase a hidden gem in every world. Grab them all and clear quickly for a three-star run.

Saves your progress

Level unlocks, best times, best lumen counts and your star ratings all persist in your browser via localStorage. Pick up right where you left off.

Ready when you are

The Hollow is dark. Pip is glowing. Go.

Arrow keys or WASD to move, Space or Up to jump. That's the whole tutorial.
